candidates.name: budget_aware_react
candidates.hypothesis: Providing a step budget warning when remaining steps are low (<= 4) for all tasks reminds the agent to finalize state changes and mark the task complete before running out of turns, preventing max_steps timeouts.
candidates.changes: In variants/agent_loop/default.py, generalize the budget nudge so that if remaining steps <= budget_nudge_steps and not nudged, a message warns of the remaining steps and instructs finalizing actions and calling the task completion API/tool.
candidates.expected_efficiency: Reduces mean turns on long tasks near the 40-step limit and prevents timeout failures.
